name: @jeswr/solid-scheduling
description: The scheduling-sector RDF model (the data model a Vikunja→Solid fork writes to a pod) — a sched:Task / sched:Calendar / sched:RecurrenceRule / sched:Reminder reusing the @jeswr/solid-federation-vocab scheduling sector, that ALSO cross-serialises through @jeswr/solid-task-model's wf:Task so a Vikunja task surfaces 'assigned to me' in Pod Manager / solid-issues. Typed accessors, a SHACL shape, an owner-only ACL helper, and fedcon:Proposal candidates for the sector gaps real task data surfaced.
author: Jesse Wright

scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology codegen/scheduling.ontology.ttl --shapes codegen/scheduling.shapes.ttl --config codegen/codegen.config.json --out src/generated
scripts.lint: biome check src scripts test codegen/codegen.config.json package.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src scripts test codegen/codegen.config.json package.json
